text.p: Tropical cyclone Josie will be a significant risk to shipping in the Mozambique Channel during the next 24-48 hours. Top winds are now 50 mph but they may reach 70 mph in 24 hours and 80-85 mph in 48 hours. The system will move from just off the west coast of Madagascar to near the southeast coast of Mozambique during this period. Coastal areas of these countries may also see beach errosion due to strong seas.
Strong westerly winds in northwestern Europe may result in local wind damage. Shipping in the North Sea and English Channel will also be under risk.

Tropical cyclone Gillian will become an increasing risk to shipping near and just east of the Queensland Australia coast during the next 24 hours. Winds of 40 mph may increase to 60-65 mph during this time. The threat will then shift to the coast of Queenslands as the system moves inland. Strong winds and strong seas will cause coastal damage as the system makes landfall. Very heavy rains will lead to flooding and mudslides as the system moves inland thereafter.
